experiments.title: Halftone Pearl
experiments.technique: Canvas 2D halftone on a fixed hex grid; scene cached in a buffer and sampled through a slow drift; GPU-blurred glow layer
experiments.controls: Plays on load. Click or any key skips the opening; click again replays. Cursor stirs the water. 'Adjust' (or T) opens the tuning panel.
experiments.blurbDraft: A scallop on the sea bed opens and a pearl lights up, drawn only with dots of light.

experiments.title: Shell Keepsake
experiments.technique: Same halftone engine; light theme draws dots as ink, sized by how dark the surface is
experiments.controls: Opens when in view. Click the shell to close it and open it again. Light / Dark toggle. 'Adjust' (or T) opens the tuning panel.
experiments.blurbDraft: A small shell that opens and offers a pearl. Light on dark, ink on paper.

experiments.title: Petal Rush
experiments.technique: three.js 0.160.0 (unpkg, pinned); real petal photos on bent, lit, translucent 3D planes; one wind field; depth of field from texture mips; real / halftone / hybrid post pass
experiments.controls: Plays on load. Click replays. Cursor stirs the resting petal. 'Adjust' (or T): petal count, breeze, gust, blur, translucency, look (real / halftone / hybrid), light / dark.
experiments.blurbDraft: One wind carries a hundred real petals toward you, then lets a single one fall asleep.
